record.original_question: Can one construct the moduli space Delta_G for more general group schemes G?

evidence.quote: Problem 8.3. Construct the moduli space ∆G for more general group schemes G.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field (of arbitrary characteristic) and let $D = \operatorname{Spec} k[[t]]$ be a formal disk with formal punctured disk $D^* = \operatorname{Spec} k((t))$. For a finite group $G$, one can consider the moduli space $\Delta_G$ (also denoted $G\text{-Cov}$) parametrizing $G$-torsors over $D^*$, equivalently connected $G$-Galois covers of the formal disk; constructions of $\Delta_G$ as a suitable (possibly non-classical, e.g.\ ind-scheme or "P-scheme") moduli object are known when $G$ is a finite (constant) group.

Problem: Extend the construction of the moduli space $\Delta_G$ of $G$-torsors over the formal punctured disk to the setting where $G$ is replaced by a more general group scheme (for instance a finite flat, possibly non-étale, group scheme over $k$ or over $\operatorname{Spec} \mathbb{Z}$, including infinitesimal group schemes such as $\mu_p$ or $\alpha_p$ in positive characteristic), giving a moduli space whose $k$-points correspond to isomorphism classes of $G$-torsors over $D^*$ and which is suitable for use in motivic integration formulas of wild McKay correspondence type.
artifact.category_tag: Moduli of torsors / wild McKay correspondence
artifact.status_search_result: The construction of $\Delta_G$ has been carried out by Tonini–Yasuda for finite (constant) groups $G$ in "Moduli of formal torsors II" (Ann. Inst. Fourier, 2023). No construction for general (e.g. non-étale finite flat) group schemes appears in the literature; the problem is listed as an open problem in Yasuda's problem list on wild McKay correspondence and no resolution was found in subsequent searches.

status_evidence.title: Moduli of formal torsors II
status_evidence.snippet: Tonini–Yasuda construct a moduli space of G-torsors over the formal punctured disk for a finite group G via P-schemes.
status_evidence.claim: The construction of Δ_G is established for finite (constant) groups G.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in the wild McKay correspondence (Yasuda problem list)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 8.3. Construct the moduli space Δ_G for more general group schemes G.
status_evidence.claim: Generalizing the construction to more general group schemes G is posed as an open problem.
